metadata.title: Exciting spiral arms in protoplanetary discs from flybys

notes: No star qualifies as a Galactic unbound candidate. The paper's "unbound" perturbers are simulated objects on parabolic flyby orbits relative to a primary star, not stars shown to be unbound from the Milky Way (T:p3-b14; T:p13-b9). The named observational systems are cited as flyby/spiral examples or possible past-flyby hosts, not selected or analyzed as Galactic unbound stars (T:p1-b17; T:p12-b5; T:p13-b5).
